ideas.title: Investigation into Alex Pretti shooting
ideas.description: An investigation into the shooting of Alex Pretti by federal agents is needed to determine the facts and circumstances surrounding the incident.
ideas.angle: The use of force by law enforcement and accountability
questions: What were the circumstances leading up to the shooting?
Was the use of force justified?
ideas.insight: The shooting of Alex Pretti raises serious concerns about the use of force by law enforcement and the need for accountability. I will investigate further to determine the facts and circumstances surrounding the incident.

ideas.title: Minnesota welfare fraud scheme
ideas.description: An investigation into allegations of welfare fraud in Minnesota is needed to determine the extent of the scheme and identify those responsible.
ideas.angle: The lack of guardrails in Minnesota's welfare system
questions: What is the extent of the welfare fraud scheme?
Who is responsible for the lack of oversight?
ideas.insight: The allegations of welfare fraud in Minnesota raise serious concerns about the state's oversight and management of welfare programs. I will investigate further to determine the extent of the scheme and identify those responsible.
